A '''Broadcast Antenna''' was one of two [[Rectenna/Legends|antennas]] that were equipped on [[Sensor beacon/Legends|sensor beacons]] such as [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech's]] [[SE-Vigilant automated sensor beacon]]. Alongside the [[Relay Pulse Antenna]], the Broadcast Antenna was located at the top of the beacon, nestled between the two [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor arrays]]. [[Homing beacon/Legends|Homing beacons]] such as the [[XXt-26 S-thread tracker]] was equipped with a Broadcast Antenna.<ref name="EGWT" />
